evidence: Cic. Cael. 42: interclūsa jam frondibus et virgultīs (Lewis & Short)
Verg. G. 2.446: vīminibus salicēs fēcundī, frondibus ulmī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The leaves of a tree taken together, singular or plural; a single leaf is folium. Not to be confused with frōns, frontis, the forehead.

phrases.latin: hīc ubi dēnsās agricolae stringunt frondēs
phrases.english: here where the farmers are stripping the thick leaves

phrases.latin: sed trūdit gemmās et frondēs explicat omnēs
phrases.english: but it pushes out its buds and unfolds all its leaves

sources: Lewis & Short: frons
